subject: Password Update Required
body:
Dear [Student Name],

This is a reminder that your LDAP password will expire on [Expiry Date]. To ensure uninterrupted access to your IIT Hyderabad accounts, please click the link below to update your password.

https://portal.training.invalid/verify

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
IT Helpdesk
IIT Hyderabad
red_flags: The link redirects to an unfamiliar site.
Missing official IT branding and logos.
The message lacks a clear, official contact option.
